about: Final-score brief for the V6 film, locked to the founder's measured voice (the master clock).

deliverable.end: music resolves under the end card, then silence from 124.31 s
deliverable.loudness: score alone about −16 LUFS integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP (the film applies −7 dB, ducks −10 dB under every line and −14 dB under the key lines)

style: Premium, minimal, intelligent AI-infrastructure founder film: late-night engineering, emotional but restrained. No generic corporate, EDM, cyberpunk, trailer hits or cheesy inspirational piano. The founder's voice always wins.

arc.brief: near silence: a low bed under the problem
Navis reveal: a subtle pulse begins under the connected systems and the pipeline
the Navis App: warm expansion, human; a held breath on Approve & send
Navis Developer: a precise developer rhythm
solo → team → one company → one understanding: broader, emotional expansion
the name: the music resolves, then silence

key_lines_duck_deeper.text: Navis turns those signals into one shared understanding.
What your company knows shouldn't have to start over.

voice_first: Leave 120–350 Hz and 2–4 kHz open under speech; no lead melody under a line.
Let the score rise in the founder's pauses (P1 2.6 s, P2 2.9 s, P5 3.1 s, P7 2.6 s) — those are written into the ducking.
